text.p: 3CI Complete Compliance Corp said on Monday it engaged Heard, McElroy & Vestal LLP as principal accountants to conduct an audit of the company's financial statements for the year ended September 30, 1996.

On October 11, the company said Arthur Anderson LLP had resigned as its principal accountant. 3CI said then that Arthur Anderson modified its 1995 opinion regarding "liquidity issues confronting the company and an explanatory paragraph describing an uncertainty with respect to the outcome of certain litigation filed against the company."

But it said for fiscal 1995 and the period through September 13,1996, when Anderson resigned, there were no disagreements with the auditors on any matters of accounting principle or practices, financial disclosure or auditing scope or procedures.
